new_claim.statement: For independent centered uniform intervals of lengths L_i>=1 and any symmetric indefinite 3x3 A with all three |lambda_i|>=1, ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= (pi/sqrt(2))*sqrt(L1^2+L2^2+L3^2)/(L1L2L3) <= pi*sqrt(3/2) < 3sqrt(2). The same bound survives arbitrary independent block-diagonal quadratic tails.

partner_result_applied.application: sup over the union of the centered-box class and the partner finite-bank class is <= C_bank=(pi sqrt(2)/3)(1+4/sqrt(5))<3sqrt(2); independent block-diagonal tails preserve the bound by convolution

unresolved_implication: Arbitrary cap-one laws are not reducible to centered boxes. The main witness frontier is genuinely non-collinear/shared-coordinate heavy rows with fragmented laws, cross-coupled tails, and multiscale or growing-activity structures.
next_step: Attack a source-valid two-or-more-heavy-row shared-coordinate family not covered by the centered-box ball majorant or one-heavy-bank theorem; preserve product provenance and test whether its peak can exceed 3sqrt(2).
